lessons.title: Lab: Tensors, autograd & nn.Module
lessons.conceptOverview: Trace the shapes of a batched linear layer. Compare a finite-difference gradient with the gradient computed by autograd.
lessons.whyItMatters: Train and debug neural networks directly.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Tensors carry shape, dtype and device. Broadcasting aligns dimensions from the right. Autograd records differentiable operations; backward accumulates gradients into leaf tensors. An nn.Module registers parameters and child layers so optimizers and checkpoints can discover them.

sections.title: 1. Establish a baseline
sections.content: Write down your inputs, expected behavior and constraints before starting. Trace the shapes of a batched linear layer. Compare a finite-difference gradient with the gradient computed by autograd.

sections.title: 2. Introduce a failure
sections.content: Test the mistaken assumption: Calling backward automatically clears old gradients. Record the observed result and the point where it diverges from your prediction.

sections.title: 3. Debug and evaluate
sections.content: Use the mechanism to explain the failure: Tensors carry shape, dtype and device. Broadcasting aligns dimensions from the right. Autograd records differentiable operations; backward accumulates gradients into leaf tensors. An nn.Module registers parameters and child layers so optimizers and checkpoints can discover them. Change one variable at a time. Repeat the baseline and add a held-out case. Submit the implementation, results and limitations.

commonMistakes: Calling backward automatically clears old gradients.
keyTakeaways: Tensors carry shape, dtype and device.

lessons.title: Lab: Data pipelines & training loops
lessons.conceptOverview: Overfit a tiny batch first. Introduce a missing zero_grad call, inspect gradient norms, then fix the loop. Save model and optimizer states plus the epoch and random seeds.
lessons.whyItMatters: Train and debug neural networks directly.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Split training and validation data before fitting preprocessing. Dataset defines examples; DataLoader handles batching and shuffling. Each training step clears gradients, runs the forward pass, computes loss, backpropagates and updates parameters. Validation uses eval mode and disables gradient recording; these are separate controls.

lessons.title: Lab: GPU training, precision & debugging
lessons.conceptOverview: Build a small classifier in a local PyTorch environment. Compare CPU and GPU step time, validation loss and checkpoint restoration. Report warmup separately.
lessons.whyItMatters: Train and debug neural networks directly.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Move both inputs and parameters to the same device. Mixed precision can reduce activation memory, but sensitive reductions may need higher precision. FP16 often needs loss scaling. Profile data loading before adding GPUs; distributed data parallelism replicates the model and synchronizes gradients.
